verdict.rationale: Restate is a durable-execution platform for building AI agents, so consuming MCP server tools is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents Restate connecting to or consuming external MCP servers. The official MCP server noted at the ai-assistant page is a server-side documentation aid for coding agents, and the tools pattern covers Restate-hosted durable tool services, so neither counts as MCP-client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
